evidence_basis.observation: Seed2002 joint4 passed all four task-level gates, but its single-task0 positive control scored 13/20 paired and 0/5 fixed-init3; under the preregistered interpretation, the matched comparison is inconclusive.

question: Does the current task0-only 40k recipe reproducibly meet its positive-control gate on one further independent training seed after the seed2002 control failed the fixed-init3 criterion?

falsifiable_hypothesis.claim: A fresh task0-only model trained for 40,000 updates on training seed 2003 will achieve at least 11/20 paired successes and 5/5 aggregate fixed-init3 successes under the unchanged evaluation protocol.
falsifiable_hypothesis.falsifier: Paired successes below 11/20 or aggregate fixed-init3 successes below 5/5.
falsifiable_hypothesis.interpretation_if_passed: One additional passing seed would show the control can pass again, but seed2002's 0/5 fixed-init3 still demonstrates seed-to-seed variation; this does not prove a joint-training effect or unlock expansion.
falsifiable_hypothesis.interpretation_if_failed: The positive-control recipe remains unstable across the tested seeds; stop this diagnostic line and do not use the seed2002 comparison to claim joint retention loss.

options_compared.option: Repeat the full task0 40k plus joint4 160k matched pair and 120 evaluations on seed2003
options_compared.reason: More direct same-training-seed replication, but spends five times as many optimizer updates and five times as many rollouts before resolving the observed single-task positive-control failure.

options_compared.option: Run only a fresh task0 40k positive control and its registered 24 evaluations, then descriptively compare against the existing seed2002 task0 outcomes on the same evaluation inits
options_compared.reason: Directly tests the failed prerequisite at 20,000% fewer optimizer updates than a full pair; reuses existing joint4 records without claiming a same-training-seed causal contrast.

options_compared.option: Unlock Fold02 or train eight tasks now
options_compared.reason: The seed2002 matched-pair positive control failed its preregistered criterion; the objective keeps both expansions locked pending separate review and authorization.

bounded_candidate_budget.comparison_policy: Compare task0 outcomes with existing seed2002 single-task0 and joint4 records only at matching benchmark init and environment seed. Label as cross-training-seed descriptive diagnostics, not a causal paired training-seed experiment.
phase_gates: Require explicit user authorization before building/deploying this new-seed config or spending GPU budget.
Perform a new read-only preflight and verify source/data/model/runtime/config/code hashes, exclusive GPU lock, disk floor, and every independent output path before launch.
Launch the one training run once; only after exit 0 and full checkpoint integrity verification, run the one 24-rollout evaluation.
Preserve all failures and stop; no automatic retry or follow-up.
